rationale: In the middle campaign, the incumbent-to-GP-maximum gap is 1.50, median uncertainty is 1.76, 127 scaffolds have been observed, the last batch mean was 7.22. This supports a mixed batch with an exploration majority while preserving the available hedge channels.
expected_outcome: The batch will have a mean affinity of at least 6.8 and add at least 4 new scaffolds.
